aaron.title: Aaron
aaron.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
aaron.note: Moses's older brother, and the one God sent to do the talking when Moses said he could not. He became Israel's first high priest, and the priesthood ran through his sons after him. Most of the time he is standing next to Moses.

abdi-3.title: Abdi
abdi-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
abdi-3.note: Ezra names him among the men who had taken foreign wives.

abishua.title: Abishua
abishua.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
abishua.note: He is a high priest in Aaron's line. Chronicles runs the chain through him, and Ezra picks it up again centuries later.

achmetha.title: Achmetha
achmetha.note: The Aramaic name for Ecbatana, old capital of Media and the summer residence of the Persian kings, which is where Cyrus's decree turned up when they went looking for it.

adaiah-5.title: Adaiah
adaiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adaiah-5.note: One of the men on Ezra's list. There is nothing more than that about him.

adaiah-6.title: Adaiah
adaiah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adaiah-6.note: Another of the name on Ezra's list of men who had married foreign wives.

adar.title: Adar
adar.note: Twelfth month, late winter, and Purim falls in it, which is the whole reason Esther names it at all.

addan.title: Addan
addan.note: A place rather than a person, one of the Babylonian localities exiles came back from, and the families from it could not prove their descent.

adin.title: Adin
adin.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adin.note: Head of a family among the returning exiles, big enough that both Ezra and Nehemiah count the household.

adna.title: Adna
adna.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adna.note: Among the Israelites Ezra listed who had married foreign wives during the exile and agreed to separate from them.

adonikam.title: Adonikam
adonikam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
adonikam.note: The census of returning exiles counts 666 men of his family in Ezra. Nehemiah's copy of the same list says 667, which is the kind of disagreement these two registers have all the way through.

ahasuerus.title: Ahasuerus
ahasuerus.about: Emperor Xerxes I, living at the time of Exile and Return
ahasuerus.note: The Persian king who deposed Vashti and made Esther his queen. He is usually identified with Xerxes the First, whose reign is documented independently in Greek and Persian sources.

ahava.title: Ahava
ahava.note: A river or canal in Babylonia. Ezra gathered the exiles there before the journey to Jerusalem and proclaimed a fast, because he was ashamed to ask the king for soldiers.

ahitub-3.title: Ahitub
ahitub-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
ahitub-3.note: Generations further down the same priestly line, a later Ahitub appears in 1 Chronicles 6 and again at Ezra 7:2.

ai.title: Ai
ai.note: A fortified Canaanite city near Bethel. Israel's first attack was thrown back because of Achan's hidden sin, and once that was dealt with Joshua took the city by ambush. The site is usually identified with et-Tell, though digging there has turned up little from the right period.

akkub.title: Akkub
akkub.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub.note: The name keeps turning up among the Levites, gatekeepers and temple servants who came back from exile, in Ezra and Nehemiah alike.

akkub-3.title: Akkub
akkub-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
akkub-3.note: One of 4 men called Akkub. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

amariah-7.title: Amariah
amariah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amariah-7.note: One of 9 men called Amariah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

amariah-3.title: Amariah
amariah-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
amariah-3.note: One of 9 men called Amariah. This one is a priest from the divided-kingdom years, named twice in 1 Chronicles and Ezra.

ami.title: Ami
ami.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ami.note: He was among the descendants of Solomon's servants who came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel. Nehemiah's copy of the list calls him Amon.

amorite.title: Amorite
amorite.note: One of the peoples in Canaan before Israel came, traced in Genesis 10 to a son of Canaan, and sometimes used loosely for everyone in the hill country. Sihon and Og ruled an Amorite kingdom east of the Jordan that fell to Israel under Moses. Outside the Bible they are the Amurru of Mesopotamian texts, the people whose dynasty produced Hammurabi of Babylon.

amram-2.title: Amram
amram-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
amram-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

anathoth.title: Anathoth
anathoth.note: A priestly town in Benjamin, about three miles north of Jerusalem, and Jeremiah's home. He bought a field there as a sign of hope while announcing Jerusalem's fall. The site is identified with the village of Anata.

apharsachites.title: Apharsachites
apharsachites.about: Word sometimes translated as a title
apharsachites.note: One of the peoples Assyria and Babylon moved into Samaria after deporting Israel. They turn up in Ezra among the officials writing to the king.

apharsite.title: Apharsite
apharsite.note: One of the peoples the Assyrians had resettled in Samaria. They wrote with the Dinaites, Elamites and others to the Persian king to stop Jerusalem being rebuilt.

arah.title: Arah
arah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
arah.note: He headed a family among the returning exiles. His descendant Shecaniah's daughter married Tobiah, the Ammonite official who opposed Nehemiah's rebuilding.

archevite.title: Archevite
archevite.note: People of Erech, better known as Uruk, settled in Samaria by the Assyrians. Later they wrote to the Persian king against the rebuilding of Jerusalem's temple. Uruk itself was one of the world's earliest cities, the traditional setting of the Epic of Gilgamesh, and its ruins have been dug in modern Iraq.

ariel-2.title: Ariel
ariel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ariel-2.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

artaxerxes.title: Artaxerxes
artaxerxes.note: He funded Ezra's return to Jerusalem with the temple articles and orders to teach the law, and later sent Nehemiah to rebuild the city's walls. A Persian king backing Judah's restoration.

asahel-4.title: Asahel
asahel-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
asahel-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

asaph.title: Asaph
asaph.about: Singer living at the time of Divided Monarchy
asaph.note: A Levite David put in charge of one of the temple choirs. Twelve psalms carry his name, Psalm 50 and Psalms 73 to 83, which means either he wrote them or a guild of musicians kept his name for generations.

asnah.title: Asnah
asnah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
asnah.note: His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

asnapper.title: Asnapper
asnapper.about: King living at the time of Exile and Return
asnapper.note: Identified with Ashurbanipal, the last powerful king of the Neo-Assyrian Empire, who resettled conquered peoples in Samaria. The opponents of the Jews name him in their letter asking the Persian king to stop Jerusalem being rebuilt. His library at Nineveh held thousands of tablets, the Epic of Gilgamesh among them.

asshur.title: Asshur
asshur.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
asshur.note: Shem's son, whose name stuck to the land and empire of Assyria on the upper Tigris. Assyria became the great power of the eighth and seventh centuries BC, deported Israel's northern tribes after Samaria fell, and kept threatening Judah.

ater.title: Ater
ater.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ater.note: He headed a family of returning exiles. Ezra's record also lists a family of temple gatekeepers by the same name.

ater-2.title: Ater
ater-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ater-2.note: He heads a family among the returning exiles. A family of gatekeepers carries the same name and is counted separately.

athaliah-3.title: Athaliah
athaliah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
athaliah-3.note: One of 3 men called Athaliah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

athlai.title: Athlai
athlai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
athlai.note: One of Bebai's descendants who had married foreign women during the exile and agreed to separate from them under Ezra. He appears only in this list.

azarael-4.title: Azarael
azarael-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azarael-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

azariah.title: Azariah
azariah.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah.note: This is King Uzziah of Judah under his other name.

azariah-3.title: Azariah
azariah-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
azariah-3.note: A priest in the genealogy of 1 Chronicles 6, named again at Ezra 7:3, and neither the king nor Daniel's friend.

azgad.title: Azgad
azgad.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
azgad.note: A large family among the returning exiles carried his name, listed by household in Ezra and Nehemiah both.

aziza.title: Aziza
aziza.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
aziza.note: Ezra 10:27 names him in Zattu's family, one of the men who had married a foreign wife after the return and had to send her away under Ezra's reforms.

azmaveth.title: Azmaveth
azmaveth.about: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
azmaveth.note: He fought for David and made the list of David's thirty. The same name belonged to a town near Jerusalem and to several other men. His own record is a line in each of the two lists of the thirty.

baanah-3.title: Baanah
baanah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
baanah-3.note: One of 4 men called Baanah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

babel.title: Babel
babel.note: The plain in Shinar where people, still speaking one language after the flood, set out to build a city and a tower reaching to the heavens and make a name for themselves. God answered by confusing their language.

babylon.title: Babylon
babylon.note: The Mesopotamian empire that destroyed Jerusalem and its temple in 586 BC and carried Judah off. Later Scripture, Revelation included, uses its name as shorthand for worldly power.

babylonia.title: Babylonia
babylonia.note: It was the region of lower Mesopotamia, around the Euphrates and Tigris, with Babylon as its capital. Its armies conquered Judah in 586 BC and destroyed Jerusalem and Solomon's temple.

bakbuk.title: Bakbuk
bakbuk.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bakbuk.note: The name means bottle or flask. His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

bani-2.title: Bani
bani-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-2.note: Ezra names him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bani-5.title: Bani
bani-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

bani-6.title: Bani
bani-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bani-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

barkos.title: Barkos
barkos.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
barkos.note: His family were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back from Babylonian exile but could not prove their Israelite descent from the records.

barzillai.title: Barzillai
barzillai.about: David's compatriot living at the time of United Monarchy
barzillai.note: When David fled from Absalom, this old and wealthy Gileadite fed him and his men. David later offered him a place at court. Barzillai turned it down.

bazlith.title: Bazlith
bazlith.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bazlith.note: Also spelled Bazluth. His family of temple servants, Nethinim, came back from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel, and nothing further is recorded about him.

bebai.title: Bebai
bebai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bebai.note: Head of a family among the returning exiles, and prominent enough to be among those who sealed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bedeiah.title: Bedeiah
bedeiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bedeiah.note: One of the sons of Bani who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away under Ezra's reform, around 458 BC.

beeroth.title: Beeroth
beeroth.note: It was one of four Hivite cities, with Gibeon, Chephirah and Kiriath-jearim. Their people tricked Joshua into a peace treaty by dressing up as travellers from far away. Later it was allotted to Benjamin.

benaiah-10.title: Benaiah
benaiah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benaiah-10.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

benaiah-11.title: Benaiah
benaiah-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benaiah-11.note: One of 12 men called Benaiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

benaiah-12.title: Benaiah
benaiah-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benaiah-12.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

benaiah-9.title: Benaiah
benaiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benaiah-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

benjamin.title: Benjamin
benjamin.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
benjamin.note: Jacob's twelfth son and the youngest, born to Rachel on the road near Bethlehem as she died giving birth to him. Jacob guarded him fiercely after losing Joseph. That fear drives much of the tension in Joseph's story.

benjamin-3.title: Benjamin
benjamin-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
benjamin-3.note: One of 5 men called Benjamin. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

besai.title: Besai
besai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
besai.note: His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, among those who returned from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel.

beth-el.title: Beth-el
beth-el.note: About ten miles north of Jerusalem, and once the Canaanite city of Luz. Abram built an altar there. Jacob dreamed of a ladder reaching to heaven there and called the place house of God.

bethlehem.title: Bethlehem
bethlehem.note: House of bread. It is a small town about five miles south of Jerusalem, earlier called Ephrath, where Rachel died and was buried and where Ruth gleaned in Boaz's fields. David was born there and anointed there.

bezai.title: Bezai
bezai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bezai.note: He headed a family among the returning exiles and signed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bezaleel-2.title: Bezaleel
bezaleel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bezaleel-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bigvai.title: Bigvai
bigvai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bigvai.note: They came back with Zerubbabel, the family Bigvai headed, and he later signed Nehemiah's covenant renewal.

bigvai-2.title: Bigvai
bigvai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bigvai-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

bilshan.title: Bilshan
bilshan.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bilshan.note: One of the leaders who came back to Judah from Babylonian exile with Zerubbabel around 538 BC. His name means something like eloquent, or man of the tongue.

binnui.title: Binnui
binnui.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui.note: A common Levitical name. Men called Binnui turn up among the wall builders under Nehemiah and among the men confronted over foreign marriages under Ezra.

binnui-2.title: Binnui
binnui-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

binnui-3.title: Binnui
binnui-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
binnui-3.note: One of 4 men called Binnui. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

bishlam.title: Bishlam
bishlam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
bishlam.note: A Persian official in Samaria. He joined in writing to King Artaxerxes against the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls. Some scholars think the Aramaic word behind his name may not be a name at all.

bukki.title: Bukki
bukki.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
bukki.note: A priest in the high priestly line from Aaron to Zadok, named in 1 Chronicles 6 and again in Ezra's own ancestry at Ezra 7:4.

canaanite.title: Canaanite
canaanite.note: They were the people living in the land promised to Israel. The biblical genealogy traces them to Canaan, son of Ham. The Old Testament repeatedly orders them driven out because of their idol worship and other practices.

canan-2.title: Canan
canan-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
canan-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

casiphia.title: Casiphia
casiphia.note: A place in Babylonia, apparently a centre of Jewish community life. None of the returning party were Levites, so Ezra sent messengers there to find Levites and temple servants for the journey to Jerusalem.

chaldean.title: Chaldean
chaldean.note: Originally a tribal people of southern Mesopotamia who went on to found the Neo-Babylonian Empire under Nabopolassar and his son Nebuchadnezzar II. Their armies destroyed Jerusalem and its temple in 586 BC.

chelal.title: Chelal
chelal.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
chelal.note: Of the sons of Pahath-moab, he had married a foreign wife and agreed to divorce her under Ezra's reform.

chelluh.title: Chelluh
chelluh.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
chelluh.note: Another of Bani's men in the foreign-marriage list of Ezra 10, who agreed to divorce his wife in Ezra's covenant reform.

chephirah.title: Chephirah
chephirah.note: With Gibeon, Beeroth and Kiriath-jearim, one of the four Hivite towns whose people tricked Joshua into a peace treaty by posing as travellers from a far country.

cherub.title: Cherub
cherub.note: A place in Babylonia, not the winged beings. With Tel-harsa and Addan it was one of the settlements some returning exiles came from who could not prove their descent.

cyrus.title: Cyrus
cyrus.about: Emperor living at the time of Exile and Return
cyrus.note: The Persian king who took Babylon and let the deported peoples, the Jews among them, go home and rebuild their temples. Isaiah calls him by name long before he was born, God's shepherd and anointed. The Cyrus Cylinder, found in Babylon in 1879, records the same policy.

dalaiah.title: Dalaiah
dalaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
dalaiah.note: Named in the returnee lists of Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7, a family head from after the exile. It was a common name in that period, and the record gives this one nothing more.

daniel-2.title: Daniel
daniel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
daniel-2.note: One of 3 men called Daniel. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

darius.title: Darius
darius.note: Darius the Great, the Persian emperor in Ezra. Temple building in Jerusalem had stalled, and his decree let it start again. Ezra keeps the text of it.

darkon.title: Darkon
darkon.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
darkon.note: His descendants came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel among the servants of Solomon, a class of temple workers.

david.title: David
david.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
david.note: The shepherd from Bethlehem who killed Goliath and became Israel's second king, ruling a kingdom bigger than any native king held before or after. Solomon was one of his sons. Nearly half the psalms carry his name, and the Tel Dan inscription, where an enemy king boasts over the house of David, put his dynasty outside the Bible as well.

dehavites.title: Dehavites
dehavites.about: Word sometimes translated as a name
dehavites.note: One of the peoples the Assyrians had settled in Samaria, who later wrote to the Persian king against rebuilding the temple. Where they came from is uncertain; some point east of the Caspian Sea.

dinaite.title: Dinaite
dinaite.about: Word sometimes translated as a name
dinaite.note: They were among the peoples the Assyrians resettled in Samaria, and they signed the letter to Artaxerxes against rebuilding Jerusalem, which stopped the work for a time.

ebed-2.title: Ebed
ebed-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ebed-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

elam-2.title: Elam
elam-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elam-2.note: The head of a family that came back from Babylon, counted in Ezra 2 and Nehemiah 7. Some of his descendants were in the foreign-marriage list of Ezra 10.

elamite.title: Elamite
elamite.note: People from Elam, the old civilisation centred on Susa in what is now southwestern Iran. Ezra has them among those resettled in Samaria who opposed rebuilding Jerusalem, and Acts puts them in the Pentecost crowd.

elasah.title: Elasah
elasah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elasah.note: One of the two men Zedekiah sent to Babylon, and Jeremiah gave them his letter to the exiles to carry.

eleazar.title: Eleazar
eleazar.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
eleazar.note: Aaron's third son. Nadab and Abihu died for offering unauthorized fire, and Eleazar became high priest after his father. He worked with Moses on the second census and with Joshua on dividing the land, and his line held the high priesthood for most of the history after.

eleazar-5.title: Eleazar
eleazar-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eleazar-5.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eleazar-6.title: Eleazar
eleazar-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eleazar-6.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

eliashib-6.title: Eliashib
eliashib-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-6.note: One of 9 men called Eliashib. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

eliashib-7.title: Eliashib
eliashib-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-7.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

eliashib-8.title: Eliashib
eliashib-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-8.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

eliashib-9.title: Eliashib
eliashib-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliashib-9.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eliezer-6.title: Eliezer
eliezer-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliezer-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

eliezer-7.title: Eliezer
eliezer-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliezer-7.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

eliezer-8.title: Eliezer
eliezer-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliezer-8.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eliezer-9.title: Eliezer
eliezer-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliezer-9.note: One of 11 men called Eliezer. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

elihoenai-3.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elihoenai-3.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

elihoenai-6.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elihoenai-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

elihoenai-7.title: Elihoenai
elihoenai-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elihoenai-7.note: One of 8 men called Elihoenai. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

elijah-3.title: Elijah
elijah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elijah-3.note: One of 4 men called Elijah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

elijah-4.title: Elijah
elijah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elijah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

eliphalet-4.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliphalet-4.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

eliphalet-5.title: Eliphalet
eliphalet-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
eliphalet-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

elnathan-3.title: Elnathan
elnathan-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
elnathan-3.note: One of 3 men called Elnathan. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

esar-haddon.title: Esar-haddon
esar-haddon.about: King living at the time of Divided Monarchy
esar-haddon.note: Sennacherib was murdered and Esarhaddon took the Assyrian throne after him. He carried Manasseh of Judah off to Babylon, and his own inscriptions list Manasseh among the vassal kings paying him tribute.

ezra.title: Ezra
ezra.about: Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
ezra.note: The priest and scribe who led a second return from exile, from Babylon to Jerusalem. In Nehemiah 8 he reads the law aloud to the whole assembled people, and they weep.

gaba.title: Gaba
gaba.note: Another English spelling of Geba, a Levitical city in Benjamin by the pass of Michmash. Jonathan raided a Philistine garrison there, and later it marked the line between the northern and southern kingdoms.

gahar.title: Gahar
gahar.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gahar.note: They came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, the descendants of Gahar, one of the families of temple servants called the Nethinim.

gazzam.title: Gazzam
gazzam.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gazzam.note: Temple servants, the Nethinim, who came home from Babylon with Zerubbabel, counted under his name. Nothing further is known of him.

gedaliah-3.title: Gedaliah
gedaliah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
gedaliah-3.note: One of 5 men called Gedaliah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

gershon.title: Gershon
gershon.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
gershon.note: Levi's eldest son. His descendants carried the tabernacle's coverings, curtains and hangings by cart through the wilderness. Exodus 2:22 and 18:3, filed under this name, belong to a different man.

gibbar.title: Gibbar
gibbar.note: The family came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, ninety-five of them. Nehemiah 7:25 gives the name as Gibeon.

giddel.title: Giddel
giddel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
giddel.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, in the lists of exiles coming home.

giddel-2.title: Giddel
giddel-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
giddel-2.note: Head of a family among the temple servants, and separately among Solomon's servants, both counted in the return lists.

gileadite.title: Gileadite
gileadite.note: Someone from Gilead, east of the Jordan, or of the clan named after Machir's son. Jephthah is the best known, the judge who beat the Ammonites and made the rash vow about his daughter.

habaiah.title: Habaiah
habaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
habaiah.note: His family were priests who came back from Babylon and could not prove their descent from Aaron. They were kept out of the priesthood until a high priest could settle it with the Urim and Thummim, and the record never says that happened.

hadid.title: Hadid
hadid.note: Exiles back from Babylon resettled it, a Benjamin town grouped with Lod and Ono in the lists. It is el-Haditheh, a few miles east of Lydda.

hagab.title: Hagab
hagab.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hagab.note: His descendants were temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hagaba.title: Hagaba
hagaba.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hagaba.note: Hagabah in Nehemiah's copy of the list. The family were temple servants, the Nethinim, home from exile with Zerubbabel.

haggai.title: Haggai
haggai.about: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
haggai.note: The exiles were back and building their own houses while God's temple stayed a ruin, and Haggai told them that was why they were struggling. His short book is dated to the month and day in 520 BC. He got the building going again, and Zerubbabel and the high priest Joshua finished it a few years later.

hakkatan.title: Hakkatan
hakkatan.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hakkatan.note: Johanan, who led the family of Azgad back to Jerusalem with Ezra, was his son.

hakupha.title: Hakupha
hakupha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hakupha.note: They were temple servants, the Nethinim, back from Babylon with Zerubbabel around 538 BC, and they are counted under his name. Nothing is known of Hakupha beyond the listing.

hanani-4.title: Hanani
hanani-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hanani-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

hananiah-7.title: Hananiah
hananiah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hananiah-7.note: One of 15 men called Hananiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

harhur.title: Harhur
harhur.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harhur.note: His name means fever. His descendants were temple servants, Nethinim, who came back with Zerubbabel, and nothing more is known of him.

harim.title: Harim
harim.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
harim.note: The third priestly course in 1 Chronicles 24:8 went by this name, and the family came back from exile. Some of them were among the men Ezra confronted for marrying foreign wives.

harim-2.title: Harim
harim-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harim-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

harsha.title: Harsha
harsha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
harsha.note: Temple servants, Nethinim, back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and his family was one of them. The name means worker, or possibly enchanter.

hashabiah.title: Hashabiah
hashabiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashabiah.note: He served in Ezra's day; the name was a common Levitical one, carried by musicians, officials and administrators over several generations.

hashum.title: Hashum
hashum.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashum.note: Head of a family among the exiles who came back. Ezra 10:33 lists men of his family who had married foreign wives.

hashupha.title: Hashupha
hashupha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hashupha.note: Also spelled Hasupha. His family were Nethinim, temple servants, and they came back in the first group from Babylon. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hatipha.title: Hatipha
hatipha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hatipha.note: Of the Nethinim, the temple servants. His family came back from exile to Jerusalem.

hatita.title: Hatita
hatita.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hatita.note: Gatekeepers of the temple. His family held the post and came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

hattil.title: Hattil
hattil.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattil.note: Among Solomon's servants, temple workers whose families came back with Zerubbabel, his was one. Nothing further is recorded about him.

hattush-3.title: Hattush
hattush-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hattush-3.note: One of 4 men called Hattush. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

henadad.title: Henadad
henadad.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
henadad.note: His Levitical family helped oversee the temple rebuilding under Zerubbabel and, a generation on, the walls under Nehemiah.

hezekiah-2.title: Hezekiah
hezekiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hezekiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

hillkiah.title: Hillkiah
hillkiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
hillkiah.note: The high priest under Josiah who found a forgotten scroll of the law while the temple was being repaired. What he found set off Judah's last great reform.

hittite.title: Hittite
hittite.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
hittite.note: Ephron the Hittite sold Abraham the cave of Machpelah at Hebron, and Uriah, the soldier whose wife David took, was a Hittite too. Critics once doubted there was ever a Hittite nation, until digs at Boghazkoy in Turkey found its capital. The Hittites in Canaan were probably a smaller offshoot, or the name used loosely.

hodaviah-3.title: Hodaviah
hodaviah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
hodaviah-3.note: The name means praise the LORD, and several men carry it in the genealogies. This one is in the return lists.

iddo.title: Iddo
iddo.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
iddo.note: Zechariah the prophet is called his grandson in Zechariah's opening lines and his son in Ezra, so the family is remembered through him.

iddo-7.title: Iddo
iddo-7.about: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
iddo-7.note: Ezra's company was short of temple ministers, so Ezra sent to this Iddo, the leader at the place where they could be found.

immer-3.title: Immer
immer-3.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and nothing else is recorded.

immer.title: Immer
immer.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
immer.note: Head of one of David's twenty-four priestly divisions, and his family name comes back with the returning exiles.

isaiah.title: Isaiah
isaiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
isaiah.note: Amoz's son, a prophet in Jerusalem in the eighth century, who counselled four kings of Judah and is quoted in the New Testament more than any other prophet. He gave his two sons names that were sermons, Shear-jashub and Maher-shalal-hash-baz. When Sennacherib besieged Jerusalem he told Hezekiah the city would stand, and the Taylor Prism brags of the siege without ever claiming the city fell.

ishiah-5.title: Ishiah
ishiah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ishiah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

ishmael-6.title: Ishmael
ishmael-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ishmael-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

israel.title: Israel
israel.about: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
israel.note: God gave Jacob this name after he wrestled through the night at Peniel. It became the name of the nation that came from his twelve sons, and later of the northern kingdom and of the land. For the man himself, see Jacob.

ithamar.title: Ithamar
ithamar.about: Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
ithamar.note: Aaron's youngest son. Two of his brothers died for offering unauthorized fire and Eleazar became high priest, and Ithamar was put over the Levites who carried and kept the tabernacle. Eli came from his line, which held the high priesthood for a while before it went back to Eleazar's line under Zadok.

jaala.title: Jaala
jaala.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jaala.note: His family were among the Nethinim, the temple servants, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

jaasau.title: Jaasau
jaasau.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jaasau.note: In Ezra's list of men who agreed to put away the foreign wives they had married.

jahaziah.title: Jahaziah
jahaziah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jahaziah.note: When Ezra moved against the foreign marriages, he was one of the few who spoke up against it, or at least against how it was being done; the Hebrew does not make plain which.

jahaziel-5.title: Jahaziel
jahaziel-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jahaziel-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

japha.title: Japha
japha.note: The Hebrew name for Joppa, the port that is Jaffa today. Solomon's cedar came in by sea there, and so did Ezra's timber for the second temple, and Jonah sailed from it toward Tarshish. The Amarna letters already mention its guarded gate.

jarib.title: Jarib
jarib.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jarib.note: Ezra sent a Jarib, one of the leaders, to recruit Levites for the return. Chronicles lists a second man of the name in a genealogy.

jarib-2.title: Jarib
jarib-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jarib-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jashub-2.title: Jashub
jashub-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jashub-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jedaiah-2.title: Jedaiah
jedaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jedaiah-2.note: The second priestly division in Chronicles carries his name, and his descendants are counted among the priests who came back from Babylon.

jehiel-2.title: Jehiel
jehiel-2.note: Jeuel, in most translations. One man of the name lived in Jerusalem after the exile; another came back with Ezra.

jehiel-10.title: Jehiel
jehiel-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehiel-10.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jehiel-11.title: Jehiel
jehiel-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehiel-11.note: One of 10 men called Jehiel. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

jehiel-8.title: Jehiel
jehiel-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehiel-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

jehiel-9.title: Jehiel
jehiel-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehiel-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

jehohanan-4.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehohanan-4.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

jehohanan-5.title: Jehohanan
jehohanan-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jehohanan-5.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

jeiel-7.title: Jeiel
jeiel-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeiel-7.note: One of 7 men called Jeiel. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

jeremai.title: Jeremai
jeremai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeremai.note: Of the family of Hashum, and one of the men in Ezra's list who had married foreign wives and agreed to send them away.

jeremiah.title: Jeremiah
jeremiah.about: Prophet living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeremiah.note: A priest's son from Anathoth, called as a young man in Josiah's thirteenth year. For four decades he told Judah Babylon was coming, and for that he was jailed, dropped in a cistern, and had his scroll burned. He saw Jerusalem fall as he had said, then was dragged off to Egypt against his will. His scribe Baruch may be the Berekhyahu on a clay seal from his lifetime.

jericho.title: Jericho
jericho.note: Israel crossed the Jordan and Jericho was the first city it took, walled and gated, with its own king. Achan died for what he stole from the plunder there, a Babylonian robe and silver that belonged to God. By then the place was already ancient: digging at the site has turned up remains about ten thousand years old.

jerusalem.title: Jerusalem
jerusalem.note: David took it from the Jebusites and made it his capital, and once Solomon's temple stood there it was the centre of Israel's worship for a thousand years. Babylon destroyed it, the exiles rebuilt it, Rome destroyed it again in AD 70. Jesus died and rose just outside its walls, and Revelation ends with a new Jerusalem coming down from heaven.

jeshua-9.title: Jeshua
jeshua-9.about: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-9.note: Jozadak's son, high priest of the Jews under Zerubbabel, and in Ezra 5:2 the two of them get up and start building the house of God again. The prophets of that day call him Joshua.

jeshua-2.title: Jeshua
jeshua-2.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
jeshua-2.note: One of the priestly houses, in the temple rota of Chronicles and again among the priests who came back from Babylon in Ezra and Nehemiah.

jeshua.title: Jeshua
jeshua.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua.note: Joshua, shortened the way people said it after the exile. The man who carries it furthest is Jeshua son of Jozadak, the high priest who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel and rebuilt the altar and then the temple. Haggai and Zechariah call him Joshua and set him beside Zerubbabel as a picture of the coming priest-king.

jeshua-3.title: Jeshua
jeshua-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-3.note: One of 8 men called Jeshua. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

jeshua-5.title: Jeshua
jeshua-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeshua-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

jewry.title: Jewry
jewry.note: An older English word for Judea, used a few times in the King James Version for the Jewish homeland.

jeziah.title: Jeziah
jeziah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jeziah.note: One of the descendants of Parosh in Ezra's long list of men who had married foreign wives and agreed to put them away. Nothing beyond this single mention is known of him.

joab-2.title: Joab
joab-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joab-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

joab-4.title: Joab
joab-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joab-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

joel-13.title: Joel
joel-13.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joel-13.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

johanan-5.title: Johanan
johanan-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
johanan-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

joiarib-2.title: Joiarib
joiarib-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joiarib-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jonathan-7.title: Jonathan
jonathan-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jonathan-7.note: One of 6 men called Jonathan. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

jonathan-8.title: Jonathan
jonathan-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jonathan-8.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

jorah.title: Jorah
jorah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jorah.note: One hundred and twelve of his family came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

josabad-5.title: Josabad
josabad-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josabad-5.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

josabad-6.title: Josabad
josabad-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josabad-6.note: One of 9 men called Josabad. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

josabad-7.title: Josabad
josabad-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josabad-7.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

joseph-6.title: Joseph
joseph-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
joseph-6.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

josiphiah.title: Josiphiah
josiphiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
josiphiah.note: His son Shelomith brought about 160 men back to Jerusalem with Ezra.

jozadak.title: Jozadak
jozadak.about: High Priest living at the time of Exile and Return
jozadak.note: A high priest taken into exile in Babylon. His son Joshua led the priesthood when the exiles came back and rebuilt the temple. Most of his story sits under Jehozadak.

jozadak-2.title: Jozadak
jozadak-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
jozadak-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

judah.title: Judah
judah.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
judah.note: Leah's fourth son, and the brother who ends up leading. He talked the others into selling Joseph rather than killing him, and later offered himself as a hostage in Benjamin's place. His tribe produced David's royal line and gave its name to the southern kingdom, and Jacob's dying blessing promised the sceptre would not leave him.

judah-2.title: Judah
judah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
judah-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

kadmiel.title: Kadmiel
kadmiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kadmiel.note: A Levite who led worship and helped oversee the rebuilding when the exiles came back, under Zerubbabel and later under Nehemiah.

kelaiah.title: Kelaiah
kelaiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kelaiah.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

kelaiah-2.title: Kelaiah
kelaiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
kelaiah-2.note: He was a Levite who had married a foreign wife and agreed under Ezra to send her away. He is also called Kelita, and is probably the Kelita who helped people understand the reading of the law.

keros.title: Keros
keros.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
keros.note: Ancestor of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

koz.title: Koz
koz.about: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
koz.note: Ancestor of a priestly family that came back from exile and could not prove its descent, and until that was settled they were kept out of the priesthood.

lebana.title: Lebana
lebana.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
lebana.note: Ancestor of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

lebanon.title: Lebanon
lebanon.note: Two mountain ridges along the coast, Lebanon proper to the west and the Anti-Lebanon rising to Mount Hermon, with the Beqaa Valley between. Solomon's temple and palace were built of its cedar, cut and floated south under a deal with Hiram of Tyre. Israel was promised it and never took all of it.

levi.title: Levi
levi.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
levi.note: Jacob's third son. He and Simeon massacred the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped, and Jacob cursed them both for it on his deathbed. Even so, Levi's descendants became Israel's priestly tribe, given service at the tabernacle instead of land, partly for their zeal against the golden calf at Sinai.

levite.title: Levite
levite.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
levite.note: They belonged to the tribe of Levi and served at the tabernacle and later the temple, helping the priests, who came from Aaron's branch of the same tribe. Their work was religious, so they got no tribal land, only forty eight towns among the other tribes and the tithes of Israel. Over time they carried and guarded the holy things, sang, kept the gates, and taught the law.

lod.title: Lod
lod.note: They called it Lydda in New Testament Greek. Over seven hundred people came back from exile to this town of Benjamin, on the plain along the road from Jerusalem to Joppa. Modern Lod, by Tel Aviv's airport, keeps the name.

maadai.title: Maadai
maadai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maadai.note: Ezra's reform listed him among the men who had married foreign wives after the return and agreed to send them away.

maaseiah-10.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-10.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

maaseiah-11.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-11.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

maaseiah-8.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-8.note: One of 20 men called Maaseiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

maaseiah-9.title: Maaseiah
maaseiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
maaseiah-9.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

machnadebai.title: Machnadebai
machnadebai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
machnadebai.note: Ezra's register of men who had married foreign wives and agreed to give them up includes him.

magbish.title: Magbish
magbish.note: One hundred fifty-six men came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel under this name. Whether it is a town or an ancestor is argued, and if a town, no one has found it.

mahli.title: Mahli
mahli.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
mahli.note: Merari's son and Levi's grandson. His family became one of the Levitical clans with work at the tabernacle.

malchijah-4.title: Malchijah
malchijah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

malchijah-5.title: Malchijah
malchijah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malchijah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

malluch-3.title: Malluch
malluch-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malluch-3.note: One of 5 men called Malluch. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

malluch-4.title: Malluch
malluch-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
malluch-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

manasseh-3.title: Manasseh
manasseh-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
manasseh-3.note: One of 4 men called Manasseh. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

manasseh-4.title: Manasseh
manasseh-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
manasseh-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

mattaniah-6.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

mattaniah-7.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-7.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-7.note: One of 10 men called Mattaniah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

mattaniah-8.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

mattaniah-9.title: Mattaniah
mattaniah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattaniah-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

mattathah.title: Mattathah
mattathah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattathah.note: Of Judah, and listed in Ezra 10:33 among the men who had married foreign wives and were made to send them away. The name probably shortens Mattithiah, "gift of the LORD."

mattenai.title: Mattenai
mattenai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattenai.note: In Ezra's reform a Mattenai was called out for a foreign marriage. The name was common after the exile.

mattenai-2.title: Mattenai
mattenai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattenai-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

mattithiah-n-3.title: Mattithiah. n
mattithiah-n-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mattithiah-n-3.note: One of 4 men called Mattithiah. n. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

mehida.title: Mehida
mehida.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mehida.note: Head of a family of Nethinim, temple servants whose descendants came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. That is all that survives.

meraioth.title: Meraioth
meraioth.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
meraioth.note: A priestly name that comes up in the high priest's family line, in Chronicles and in Ezra's own genealogy.

merari.title: Merari
merari.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
merari.note: Levi's third son. His descendants had the heavy parts of the tabernacle, the frames, bars, pillars and bases, which went by cart instead of being carried.

meremoth.title: Meremoth
meremoth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meremoth.note: The priest who helped weigh the gold and silver vessels Ezra brought back from Babylon. Later he repaired a stretch of Jerusalem's wall under Nehemiah.

meremoth-2.title: Meremoth
meremoth-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meremoth-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

meshullam-11.title: Meshullam
meshullam-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-11.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

meshullam-12.title: Meshullam
meshullam-12.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-12.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

meshullam-13.title: Meshullam
meshullam-13.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
meshullam-13.note: One of 20 men called Meshullam. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

miamin-3.title: Miamin
miamin-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
miamin-3.note: One of 3 men called Miamin. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

michael-10.title: Michael
michael-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
michael-10.note: One of 11 men called Michael. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

mikmas.title: Mikmas
mikmas.note: Michmash, a town in Benjamin north of Jerusalem. The Philistines gathered there against Saul, and Jonathan and his armour-bearer climbed across a rocky ravine to attack their garrison, which set off a rout. Isaiah pictures the Assyrian army leaving its baggage there, and families from Michmash came back from Babylon.

mithredath.title: Mithredath
mithredath.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mithredath.note: Cyrus's treasurer, whose name in Persian is Mithridates, "given by Mithra." At the king's order he counted out the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had carried off from Jerusalem and handed them to the returning exiles. Another Mithredath, an official in Samaria, signed a letter to Artaxerxes against the rebuilding.

mithredath-2.title: Mithredath
mithredath-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mithredath-2.note: He was Cyrus's treasurer, the man who handed back the temple vessels Nebuchadnezzar had taken. The name is Persian.

mizpar.title: Mizpar
mizpar.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mizpar.note: Ezra's spelling of Mispereth, one of the leaders who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

mordecai-2.title: Mordecai
mordecai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
mordecai-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

moses.title: Moses
moses.about: Levite living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
moses.note: Born a Hebrew slave in Egypt and raised in Pharaoh's house, he killed an Egyptian overseer and ran to Midian, where he kept sheep for forty years. God called him back from the burning bush to face Pharaoh and lead Israel out. He gave them the law at Sinai, led them forty years in the wilderness, and died at a hundred and twenty within sight of the promised land.

nathan-5.title: Nathan
nathan-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nathan-5.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

nathan-6.title: Nathan
nathan-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nathan-6.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

nebo-2.title: Nebo
nebo-2.note: The other Nebo, a town in Benjamin. A family from it came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

nebuchadnezzar.title: Nebuchadnezzar
nebuchadnezzar.about: Emperor living at the time of Divided Monarchy
nebuchadnezzar.note: King of Babylon. He destroyed Jerusalem and its temple in 586 BC and carried Judah off, and the Bible still calls him the tool God used to judge his people. Daniel tells how, after boasting of his greatness, he went mad and lived like an animal for seven years, until he gave God the glory and got his throne back.

nehemiah-2.title: Nehemiah
nehemiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nehemiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

nekoda.title: Nekoda
nekoda.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nekoda.note: His family were temple servants who came back from exile and could not prove their descent.

nekoda-2.title: Nekoda
nekoda-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nekoda-2.note: Head of a family among the temple servants who came back from exile and could not prove their descent. Several families had the same problem.

nephusim.title: Nephusim
nephusim.note: The margin's spelling of a family of temple servants, or Nethinim, who returned with Zerubbabel; Nehemiah calls them Nephushesim.

nethaneel-8.title: Nethaneel
nethaneel-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
nethaneel-8.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

nethinims.title: Nethinims
nethinims.note: Temple servants, probably war captives to begin with, given the heavy work around the Levites. Groups of them come back from Babylon in the return lists.

nethinims-2.title: Nethinims
nethinims-2.note: The same temple servants, here under the tax exemption the king grants them.

netophah.title: Netophah
netophah.note: "Dripping," probably for a spring, the name of a town near Bethlehem. Some of its people came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and two of David's best soldiers were Netophathites.

neziah.title: Neziah
neziah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
neziah.note: Head of a family of Nethinim, temple servants whose descendants came back with Zerubbabel. Nothing more survives.

no.title: No
no.note: Nahum points to the fall of No, the Hebrew name for the Egyptian city of Thebes, as a warning to Nineveh that no city is too strong for God's judgment.

noadiah.title: Noadiah
noadiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
noadiah.note: When Ezra's company reached Jerusalem, the temple silver and gold were weighed out, and Noadiah was one of the Levites on hand (Ezra 8:33). Nothing else is said about him.

obadiah-11.title: Obadiah
obadiah-11.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
obadiah-11.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

ono.title: Ono
ono.note: Nehemiah's enemies Sanballat and Tobiah asked him four times to come down and meet them in the plain of Ono, and he would not go. The town belonged to Benjamin, in a fertile plain northwest of Jerusalem, and returning exiles settled it again.

padon.title: Padon
padon.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
padon.note: His family were Nethinim, temple servants who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel, and nothing further is recorded about him.

pahathmoab.title: Pahathmoab
pahathmoab.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pahathmoab.note: A big family among the returning exiles, big enough that Ezra and Nehemiah both list it house by house.

parosh.title: Parosh
parosh.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
parosh.note: The family of Parosh heads the list of lay families who came back from exile. A large house, and Ezra puts it first.

parosh-2.title: Parosh
parosh-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
parosh-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

paseah.title: Paseah
paseah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
paseah.note: He headed one of the families of temple servants who came back from exile.

pashur.title: Pashur
pashur.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
pashur.note: His name heads a family that came back from exile, counted in Ezra 2:38 and Nehemiah 7:41. He is not the temple official who had Jeremiah beaten; that man has his own entry.

perida.title: Perida
perida.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
perida.note: His family were servants of Solomon, and their descendants, the house of Perida or Peruda, came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel.

perizzite.title: Perizzite
perizzite.note: They come almost every time in a list, paired with the Canaanites, as one of the peoples living in Canaan before Israel arrived.

persia.title: Persia
persia.note: The empire that took Babylon under Cyrus. Unlike the empires before it, Persia let the exiled Jews go home and rebuild their temple, and Ezra keeps the decree.

pethakiah-2.title: Pethakiah
pethakiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
pethakiah-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

phinehas.title: Phinehas
phinehas.about: High Priest living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
phinehas.note: Aaron's grandson, Eleazar's son. When Israel was being struck by a plague for idolatry and sexual sin with Moabite women, Phinehas drove a spear through an Israelite man and a Midianite woman together, and the plague stopped.

phinehas-3.title: Phinehas
phinehas-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
phinehas-3.note: One of 3 men called Phinehas. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

ramah.title: Ramah
ramah.note: Samuel's hometown, and where he was buried. The name was common enough that several towns carried it. Jeremiah's Rachel weeping for her children is set here too.

ramiah.title: Ramiah
ramiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ramiah.note: A descendant of Parosh who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away under Ezra.

reaia.title: Reaia
reaia.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
reaia.note: The head of a family of temple servants who came back from exile, listed in Ezra 2:47 and Nehemiah 7:50.

reeliah.title: Reeliah
reeliah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
reeliah.note: A leader of the exiles who came home from Babylon under Zerubbabel and Jeshua (Ezra 2:2).

rehum.title: Rehum
rehum.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehum.note: A Persian official who wrote to the king against the rebuilding of Jerusalem. The letter worked, and the work stopped.

rehum-2.title: Rehum
rehum-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rehum-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

rezin-2.title: Rezin
rezin-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
rezin-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

samaria.title: Samaria
samaria.note: Omri bought a hill from a man called Shemer and built a capital on it. Samaria took over from Tirzah as the seat of the northern kingdom. Ahab and the kings after him ruled from there.

senaah.title: Senaah
senaah.note: Over three thousand of its people came back from exile with Zerubbabel, one of the largest single groups. Later, men from Senaah worked on Jerusalem's Fish Gate.

seraiah.title: Seraiah
seraiah.about: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
seraiah.note: The chief priest in Jerusalem when it fell. Nebuchadnezzar had him executed, and the name runs on through several later generations of priests.

seraiah-2.title: Seraiah
seraiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
seraiah-2.note: A Seraiah from the years of the return, not the chief priest Nebuchadnezzar executed. The name sits in Ezra 2:2 and again in the Nehemiah lists.

shabbethai.title: Shabbethai
shabbethai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shabbethai.note: A Levite of Ezra's day. He helped explain the law to the people after Ezra read it out, and he had a part in the trouble over foreign marriages.

shallum.title: Shallum
shallum.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum.note: He is a Levite of the years after the exile, named at 1 Chronicles 9:17, 9:19 and 9:31 in the lists of those who kept the gates.

shallum-10.title: Shallum
shallum-10.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum-10.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shallum-9.title: Shallum
shallum-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shallum-9.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

shallum-3.title: Shallum
shallum-3.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
shallum-3.note: A priest on the line that comes down to Ezra. He appears in 1 Chronicles 6:12 and 6:13 and again in Ezra 7:2.

shalmai.title: Shalmai
shalmai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shalmai.note: Head of a family of the Nethinim, the temple servants, whose descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel. Nehemiah 7:48 spells the name Salmai.

shalthiel.title: Shalthiel
shalthiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shalthiel.note: Zerubbabel's father. He came from the exiled king Jehoiachin, so through him David's royal line can be traced through the Babylonian captivity.

shamariah-3.title: Shamariah
shamariah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shamariah-3.note: One of 4 men called Shamariah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

shamariah-4.title: Shamariah
shamariah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shamariah-4.note: He came over to David at Ziklag with the other warriors. A son of Rehoboam carries the name too.

sharai.title: Sharai
sharai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sharai.note: One of the sons of Bani who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away under Ezra's reform.

shashai.title: Shashai
shashai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shashai.note: Another of Bani's descendants who had married a foreign wife and agreed to give her up after the exile.

sheal.title: Sheal
sheal.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sheal.note: A son of Bani who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away under Ezra (Ezra 10:29). Nothing more is recorded of him.

shealtiel.title: Shealtiel
shealtiel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shealtiel.note: Zerubbabel's father, and the name means asked of God.

shecaniah-2.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shecaniah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shecaniah-5.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shecaniah-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

shecaniah-6.title: Shecaniah
shecaniah-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shecaniah-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shelemiah-2.title: Shelemiah
shelemiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shelemiah-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shelemiah-3.title: Shelemiah
shelemiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shelemiah-3.note: One of 8 men called Shelemiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

shelomith-6.title: Shelomith
shelomith-6.about: Woman living at the time of Exile and Return
shelomith-6.note: A woman from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

shemaiah-16.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-16.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-16.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shemaiah-17.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-17.note: One of 26 men called Shemaiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

shemaiah-18.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-18.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-18.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

shemaiah-19.title: Shemaiah
shemaiah-19.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shemaiah-19.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

shephatiah.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah.note: A family name among the returning exiles in Ezra 2:4 and Nehemiah 7:9. Ezra 8:8 has more of the same family coming back later.

shephatiah-3.title: Shephatiah
shephatiah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shephatiah-3.note: One of 9 men called Shephatiah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named twice in Ezra and Nehemiah.

sherebiah.title: Sherebiah
sherebiah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sherebiah.note: A Levite Ezra went out of his way to bring along on the journey back to Jerusalem, because of his skill and standing.

sheshbazzar.title: Sheshbazzar
sheshbazzar.about: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
sheshbazzar.note: He was handed the temple vessels to carry back, and Ezra 5:14 and 5:16 call him governor. He is probably Zerubbabel under another name.

shetharboznai.title: Shetharboznai
shetharboznai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shetharboznai.note: A Persian official. With Tattenai he asked by what authority the Jews were rebuilding the temple. The inquiry dug up Cyrus's original decree, and the work got official backing instead of being stopped.

shimeah-16.title: Shimeah
shimeah-16.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shimeah-16.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

shimeah-17.title: Shimeah
shimeah-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shimeah-17.note: One of 17 men called Shimeah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

shimeah-18.title: Shimeah
shimeah-18.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shimeah-18.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

shimshai.title: Shimshai
shimshai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shimshai.note: A Persian scribe. He and Rehum wrote to King Artaxerxes against the rebuilding of Jerusalem, and the letter stopped the work for a time.

shobai.title: Shobai
shobai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
shobai.note: His descendants were temple gatekeepers who came back from exile with Zerubbabel. The name means captor, or captive, and nothing further is recorded of him.

sia.title: Sia
sia.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sia.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim. His descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel to serve at the rebuilt temple, and Nehemiah spells him Siaha.

simeon.title: Simeon
simeon.about: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs
simeon.note: Jacob's second son. With his brother Levi he killed the men of Shechem after their sister Dinah was raped. Jacob held it against them on his deathbed.

sisera-2.title: Sisera
sisera-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sisera-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

solomon.title: Solomon
solomon.about: King living at the time of United Monarchy
solomon.note: David and Bathsheba's son, and Israel's third king. He was rushed onto the throne after his half-brother Adonijah tried to take it while David lay dying. Early on he asked God for wisdom.

sophereth.title: Sophereth
sophereth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sophereth.note: He headed a family of "Solomon's servants," temple workers whose descendants came back from exile with Zerubbabel. Nothing further is recorded about him.

sotai.title: Sotai
sotai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
sotai.note: His family were "Solomon's servants," temple workers who came back from exile with Zerubbabel.

susanchites.title: Susanchites
susanchites.note: People from Susa, the city in Elam that later became a Persian winter capital, settled in Samaria among the foreign groups who opposed rebuilding the temple in Jerusalem.

tabaoth.title: Tabaoth
tabaoth.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tabaoth.note: His family came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel among the temple servants, the Nethinim.

tabeal.title: Tabeal
tabeal.about: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
tabeal.note: Two men share the name. Isaiah 7:6 makes one the father of the man Syria and Israel meant to put on Judah's throne instead of Ahaz, and Ezra 4:7 has the other, an official in Samaria who wrote to Artaxerxes against the walls.

talmon.title: Talmon
talmon.about: Levite living at the time of Exile and Return
talmon.note: He headed a family of temple gatekeepers, and his descendants were still keeping the gates after the exile.

tamah.title: Tamah
tamah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tamah.note: Head of a family of temple servants, the Nethinim, who came back from Babylon with Zerubbabel. Some lists spell it Thamah.

tatnai.title: Tatnai
tatnai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tatnai.note: He was a Persian governor who challenged the Jews rebuilding the temple and wrote to Darius about it. The search turned up Cyrus's decree, and he was told to help instead.

tel-haresha.title: Tel-haresha
tel-haresha.note: One of the places in Babylonia that exiles returned from. The families from there could not prove they were Israelites, and nobody knows where it was.

tel-melah.title: Tel-melah
tel-melah.note: Hill of salt, a place in Babylonia. People who came back from there could not show their Israelite ancestry, and the site is unknown.

telem.title: Telem
telem.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
telem.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

thummim.title: Thummim
thummim.note: Paired with the Urim in the high priest's breastpiece, and used the same way, to put a question to God.

tikvah-2.title: Tikvah
tikvah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tikvah-2.note: Father of one of the men who stood against the foreign-marriage decision under Ezra.

tirshatha.title: Tirshatha
tirshatha.note: A Persian word for the governor of Judah, not a name. It is used of Nehemiah, and on one reading of Zerubbabel.

tobiah-2.title: Tobiah
tobiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
tobiah-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

uel.title: Uel
uel.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uel.note: A man of Bani's family who had married a foreign wife and sent her away under Ezra's reform.

uri-3.title: Uri
uri-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uri-3.note: One of 3 men called Uri. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

uriah-3.title: Uriah
uriah-3.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uriah-3.note: A man of the return, named as a father in Ezra 8:33 and in Nehemiah's list of the men rebuilding the wall.

urim.title: Urim
urim.note: The Urim and Thummim sat in the high priest's breastpiece. They were used to put yes-or-no questions to God. How they actually worked, nobody knows.

uthai-2.title: Uthai
uthai-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uthai-2.note: The name means helpful. This Uthai led a group of returning exiles home.

uzza-2.title: Uzza
uzza-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzza-2.note: Ezra and Nehemiah name him twice, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

uzzi.title: Uzzi
uzzi.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
uzzi.note: There are several. This one sits in the high priestly line in 1 Chronicles 6, and Ezra 7:4 traces Ezra back through him.

uzziah-4.title: Uzziah
uzziah-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
uzziah-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

vaniah.title: Vaniah
vaniah.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
vaniah.note: Another of Bani's descendants who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away.

zabad-4.title: Zabad
zabad-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zabad-4.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

zabad-5.title: Zabad
zabad-5.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zabad-5.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

zabad-6.title: Zabad
zabad-6.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zabad-6.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zabbai.title: Zabbai
zabbai.note: One of the men in Ezra 10:28 who had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away. He is not the Zaccai whose son Baruch worked on the wall.

zaccai.title: Zaccai
zaccai.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccai.note: They counted his family by household when it came back from exile, in Ezra and in Nehemiah.

zaccur-4.title: Zaccur
zaccur-4.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zaccur-4.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

zachariah-17.title: Zachariah
zachariah-17.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-17.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

zachariah-18.title: Zachariah
zachariah-18.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-18.note: One of 29 men called Zachariah. This one is a man from the exile and the return, named once in Ezra.

zachariah-19.title: Zachariah
zachariah-19.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-19.note: A man from the exile and the return, and Ezra is the only book that names him.

zachariah-20.title: Zachariah
zachariah-20.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-20.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zachariah-2.title: Zachariah
zachariah-2.about: Prophet living at the time of Exile and Return
zachariah-2.note: The prophet of the return whose book carries the name Zechariah. Ezra names him among those urging the people on with the temple.

zadok-2.title: Zadok
zadok-2.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zadok-2.note: A later Zadok in the priestly line, in the genealogies of Chronicles, Ezra and Nehemiah.

zattu.title: Zattu

zattu.note: He was head of a big family that came back from exile, counted by household in both Ezra and Nehemiah.

zebadiah-8.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-8.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zebadiah-8.note: A man from the exile and the return. Ezra names him once.

zebadiah-9.title: Zebadiah
zebadiah-9.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zebadiah-9.note: A common name among Levites, David's soldiers and officials after the exile; this one gets a single verse.

zebina.title: Zebina
zebina.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zebina.note: Of Nebo's descendants, he had married a foreign wife and agreed to send her away. That list is the only place he appears.

zerahiah-2.title: Zerahiah
zerahiah-2.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
zerahiah-2.note: Ezra names him once, and he is a man from the exile and the return.

zerahiah.title: Zerahiah
zerahiah.about: Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
zerahiah.note: A priest in the high priestly line, one of the links between Ezra and Aaron.

zerubbabel.title: Zerubbabel
zerubbabel.about: Governor living at the time of Exile and Return
zerubbabel.note: He came from David's line and led the first exiles back from Babylon to Jerusalem. As governor he laid the temple's foundation and, with Haggai and Zechariah pushing, saw it finished.

ziha.title: Ziha
ziha.about: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
ziha.note: Head of a family of temple servants that came back from exile.
